subject: Demo recap + proposed trial commitment plan — Nimble Retail
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimble-retail.com>, Priya Gupta <p.gupta@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed trial commitment plan — Nimble Retail

Hi Liam + Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and helpful context on the inventory search and front-end latency goals. Quick recap and a concrete proposed trial we can kick off next week: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: reduce average search latency and improve entity extraction from supplier descriptions to enable better faceted search.
- Success criteria you emphasized: P95 latency under 200ms for 75%+ of search queries; extraction precision >= 92% on the curated SKU test set; UX acceptability for autocomplete suggestions.
- Constraints: no raw PII leaves your VPC; trial dataset limited to subset of production (anonymized).

Proposed 4-week trial (high level)
1) Week 0 (Kickoff, security & data prep) — share trial config, finalize dataset slice, complete simple SCP for inbound data (we respect your data residency ask).
2) Week 1 (Baseline + integration) — run baseline on your queries (we'll seed with your sample set) and integrate streaming outputs into a sandbox UI.
3) Week 2 (Tuning & evaluation) — iterate model variant + quantization profile, collect metrics (latency, token cost, extraction P/R).
4) Week 3 (Acceptance & handoff) — run acceptance test suite, share full report and recommended production config.

Owners / points of contact
- Redwood PM / commercial: Hannah Schmitt (me) — coordination, success criteria, contract/credits.
- Redwood technical lead: Karthik Iyer — infra, model selection, rollout config.
- Nimble technical lead: Liam O'Connor — dataset curation, sandbox UI integration, acceptance sign-off.

Success metrics (proposed)
- Latency: P95 end-to-end search < 200ms for >= 75% of sample queries.
- Extraction: entity extraction F1 >= 0.92 on curated SKU set.
- Cost/ops: average token cost delta vs baseline <= 30% increase (we'll provide optimization knobs).
- Integration: streaming autocomplete stable (no client errors > 1% of requests).

Required items from Nimble by kickoff
- Anonymized dataset sample (S3 link or secure upload)
- Shortlist of 10 user journeys / representative queries
- Point of contact for sandbox UI integration

Attachments included: nimble_trial_plan_v1.pdf (detailed timeline & checkpoints), trial_config_example.json (sample config we run), nimble_poc_success_metrics.xlsx (test cases + expected thresholds).

Next steps (proposed)
1) You confirm trial scope and success criteria (reply to this thread).
2) We send a simple MSA/POA for signatures and a DocuSign link — we can run on a standard 30-day trial credit.
3) Schedule 60-min kickoff (tech + security) — I have availability Mon/Tue next week 9–11am PT.

If that all looks good I'll mark this as the committed plan and loop in Karthik to schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: nimble_trial_plan_v1.pdf (outline), trial_config_example.json (example), nimble_poc_success_metrics.xlsx (test matrix)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimble-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <p.gupta@nimble-retail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed trial commitment plan — Nimble Retail

Thanks Hannah — this is clear and a helpful starting point. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Data residency: when you say sandbox, can that run in our EU region? We need to ensure the KV cache doesn't replicate across regions.
2) Support window: during Week 2 tuning, do you provide on-call engineering during our business hours (9–5 ET) or will that be asynchronous?
3) Test harness: we'd like a simple single-node test harness so our frontend team can push queries without dealing with full infra. Can you include that in the trial config?

If you can confirm the above, we can agree to the proposed goals and aim to kickoff Monday. Also, can you send the DocuSign to legal (legal@nimble-retail.com) and cc me & Priya?

—Liam
Lead Product Manager, Nimble Retail
liam.oconnor@nimble-retail.com | +1 (212) 555-0128

Liam / Priya — quick answers and an updated note on the plan: 

1) Data residency: yes — we can provision the sandbox in your preferred region (EU available). We'll configure the KV cache policy to remain regional-only; I'll include the infra note in the trial_config_example.json.
2) Support window: Karthik will be on-call during your business hours (9–5 ET) for the Week 2 tuning window. We'll also keep an async Slack channel open (we'll invite your engineers).
3) Test harness: included. trial_config_example.json now references a lightweight single-node harness (endpoint + example curl) — we will deliver a small SDK snippet for frontend calls.

I created a DocuSign envelope and invited legal@nimble-retail.com — link: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abcd-1234-ndatest. Please let me know if I should add any other recipients.

Proposed kickoff: Mon, 26 Apr — 10am PT / 1pm ET. If that works I'll calendar-in and share agenda + meeting invite.

Thanks — I'll update the attached nimble_trial_plan_v1.pdf to reflect the EU residency and added harness.

Best,
Hannah

- Provision EU sandbox (region: eu-west-1) with regional KV cache.
- Deploy single-node harness with example endpoint + SDK snippet (Node + Python).

I'll slot ~4 hours/day during Week 2 for tuning and will join kickoff. Marissa — can you take ownership of the success-metric tracking and weekly status report to Liam?
